headline: A 2001 executive order created a presidential task force focused on helping citizens prepare for terrorism.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order set up a Presidential Task Force on Citizen Preparedness. The task force was meant to look at how ordinary Americans could be better prepared in connection with the government's response to terrorism. No summary was provided, so details such as who served on the task force, its exact duties, and any deadlines are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal officials named to the task force
who_it_affects.how: They would be assigned to study and advise on how citizens can prepare for possible terrorist attacks.
The task force's work was aimed at guidance or programs to help everyday people prepare, though the title does not say what specific steps resulted.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 9, 2001; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
